meta_description: Harrison Towing & Tire serving La Grange - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: Careful towing in La Grange, start to finish.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
coverage_h2: La Grange, and the towns around it
cta_h2: Call us and we will come to you
footer_blurb: Harrison Towing & Tire serving La Grange.
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers powersports and small equipment, winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport. We work out of La Grange and the towns around it.
area_h2: We work in and around La Grange
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Powersports and small equipment
services.body: Golf carts and yard machines are winched up and strapped down the same way a car is, so they arrive the way they left.
services.evidence: Harrison Towing and Tire's flatbed and wrecker parked side by side in a field

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.evidence: Harrison Towing and Tire's flatbed and wrecker parked side by side in a field

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.evidence: Harrison Towing and Tire service truck with the mark and phone number on the door

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.evidence: Crane truck lifting a storage container into place for a customer

reviews.author: Pamela Hartman
reviews.text: Noah was a life saver on what could have been an awful Friday the 13th - flat tire after a twelve hour night shift feeling completely overwhelmed. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Katie Lee
reviews.text: Amazing service! We blew a tire Sunday afternoon on the highway and called Harrison. Noah was there within 20 minutes. He did everything in he could to help us and not leave us stranded at a tire shop for the rest of the afternoon. We could not have asked for better, especially since it was a Sunday. 100% recommend this company.

reviews.author: L. T. Communications
reviews.text: We are new to the area and blew a trailer tire late in the evening which forced us to leave our trailer and trencher on the side of the road. We called Harrison Towing and the guy that helped us was very nice and helpful and jumped right in and helped us out - which was very late at night. I cannot thank him enough for his professionalism and willingness to help our guys get their trailer and equipment home. He went above and beyond and is very reasonably priced. I would recommend their services any day. Thanks again for your help!!

reviews.author: Marcus Lewis
reviews.text: Best company ever! I had a flat tire and needed some assistance. I called Noah and he sent a very friendly person out to help me. I’m so thankful for the prompt and professional service. Amazing!

reviews.author: Keith Bryant
reviews.text: Camper burnt up a wheel bearing. He directed us to a dealership that could work on it. Ment us there cause it was a holiday and we were able to drop the camper at the dealership and go on our way. Great to help us out and didn't ask for a dime.

reviews.author: James Robinson
reviews.text: My RV wheel bearings overheated and ruined an axle. On the side of a busy road, I called a number of towing companies and RV facilities who couldn't help. Though Harrison Towing also couldn't tow my large camper, they came out to see if they could help somehow. They directed me to a location where my camper could be stored until the axle could be replaced, following me with flashing lights as I drove there very slowly. It worked out well and I am forever grateful.

reviews.author: Faizan K
reviews.text: Noah Just dropped off me and my car to a local shop… I broke down in the middle of nowhere and am not from the area but he made sure he answered any questions I had and was very respectful and professional. He was also very fair and reasonable with his pricing.

reviews.author: Erin McHale
reviews.text: Amazing service!! Blew out a camper tire….Harrison towing was there in no time, very personable, friendly, and we’ll priced. Got the job done much quicker than expected. Would recommend to anyone!!

reviews.author: Jason Powell
reviews.text: I had just got off of work and locked my keys in the car. I didn’t wanna call him bc it was pretty early in the morning I’d said around 6:30 ish but he got right on up and told me a good price and had me back on the road and heading home within in 10 minutes.

reviews.author: Chris Leslie
reviews.text: Had a blown tire on our RV, they had quick friendly, knowledgeable service to get us back on the road quickly and safely.

reviews.author: Asheligh
reviews.text: Craig is the best tow guy you could ask for, polite, knowledgable, and will make you smile despite the car trouble that brought him to you.
